prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: one continuous top-down ground-only game terrain outpaint for Safety Last.

INPUTS: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, a 1666 × 2676 portrait template. Its leftmost 260 pixels are the actual existing eastern works edge; the white area is missing land to the east. Fill the white area and continue the existing contact without moving, resizing, rotating or cropping it. Preserve the leftmost 132 pixels exactly. Image 2 is the material and scale reference, the approved works terrain. Image 3 is a geographic guide only: this is open ground approaching the eastern factory district, not the whole world redrawn. Do not copy the guide's buildings or foliage.

PATHS: Continue the dirt road visible entering from the LEFT near 66% of image height, matching its exact entry, width and slope at the join. It curves gently east and slightly north, then exits RIGHT near 59% height. This is a wider unpaved service lane: dusty muted taupe, with subtle worn wheel ruts and only occasional small gravel. From this lane, a narrower dirt track bends north through the right half and exits TOP around 68% width, leaving a generous open works clearing beside it. A faint smaller dirt spur can lead south to the BOTTOM near 60% width for a later district. Keep the route organic and asymmetric, not a neat crossroad or paved grid.

GROUND: Preserve the same flat overhead hand-painted game texture and material scale. Gradually move from the existing olive/grey-brown contact into quieter cool brown compacted earth, deeper umber patches and irregular muted grass around the margins. Large calm areas of bare soil and low grass are essential, especially the central and upper clearing where separate buildings will later be placed. Much fewer loose pebbles and less busy texture in this open ground than the older reference; no decorative cobble carpet. Subtle material variation, not a uniform tint or a straight palette boundary along the join. Neutral overhead daylight. No orange wash. All NEW ground should be free of red/orange leaves and flowers.

NO buildings, foundations, fences, rails, props, machinery, trees, shrubs, raised grass tufts, large rocks, water, puddles, people, vehicles, cast shadows, text, grid, borders, panels, black fades, vignette or white gaps. Ground and dirt routes only. Keep the existing western contact and road entry fixed. Output a single opaque portrait image at 1666:2676 aspect ratio, highest available resolution, ideally 1666 × 2676 or larger.

references.editTarget: scripts/prepare-works-grounds.mjs reconstructs the western template at (8314,2124), 1666 × 2676.
